These are the license files for the external modules listed in the root `go.mod`. The versions are pinned there and in `go.sum`.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `modernc.org/sqlite` | `v1.62.0` | BSD-3-Clause | [modernc.org-sqlite-LICENSE.txt](modernc.org-sqlite-LICENSE.txt) |
| `github.com/dustin/go-humanize` | `v1.1.0` | MIT | [github.com-dustin-go-humanize-LICENSE.txt](github.com-dustin-go-humanize-LICENSE.txt) |
| `github.com/google/uuid` | `v1.6.0` | BSD-3-Clause | [github.com-google-uuid-LICENSE.txt](github.com-google-uuid-LICENSE.txt) |
| `github.com/mattn/go-isatty` | `v0.0.24` | MIT | [github.com-mattn-go-isatty-LICENSE.txt](github.com-mattn-go-isatty-LICENSE.txt) |
| `github.com/ncruces/go-strftime` | `v1.1.0` | MIT | [github.com-ncruces-go-strftime-LICENSE.txt](github.com-ncruces-go-strftime-LICENSE.txt) |
| `github.com/remyoudompheng/bigfft` | `v0.0.0-20230129092748-24d4a6f8daec` | BSD-3-Clause | [github.com-remyoudompheng-bigfft-LICENSE.txt](github.com-remyoudompheng-bigfft-LICENSE.txt) |
| `golang.org/x/sys` | `v0.50.0` | BSD-3-Clause | [golang.org-x-sys-LICENSE.txt](golang.org-x-sys-LICENSE.txt) |

| `modernc.org/mathutil` | `v1.7.1` | BSD-3-Clause | [modernc.org-mathutil-LICENSE.txt](modernc.org-mathutil-LICENSE.txt) |
| `modernc.org/memory` | `v1.12.1` | BSD-3-Clause | [modernc.org-memory-LICENSE.txt](modernc.org-memory-LICENSE.txt) |
